name: Fibre Arts
description: Are you interested in sewing, embroidery, or other fibre arts? Become a member and enjoy 24/7 access to our machines and host or attend classes!

benefits.title: Embroidery Machine
benefits.description: Use our embroidery machine with a 6"x10" workable area for precise, detailed embroidery on your projects.

benefits.title: Sewing Machine
benefits.description: Access a quality sewing machine for all your stitching and garment-making projects.

benefits.title: Large Layout Table
benefits.description: Work on our big table designed for cutting out patterns and assembling your fibre art projects.

benefits.title: Free and Donated Fabrics
benefits.description: Browse our collection of free and donated fabrics to find materials for your creative projects.

benefits.title: Comprehensive Fibre Arts Supplies
benefits.description: Access a variety of supplies including knitting needles, embroidery thread, looms for weaving, irons, and more.
